channel.title: Blue Pulse Studios — Newswire
channel.description: Dispatches from the rooms. Production updates and field notes from Blue Pulse Studios.

item.title: Stay Home wraps principal photography. Now we cut.
item.description: Forty-three shooting days in the woods outside Pittsburgh, two reshoot weekends, one full-day standoff with a thunderstorm that we ended up using anyway.

item.title: The scene we cut from The Painting.
item.description: There was a four-minute scene where the painter walks the same hallway twice and the second time the door at the end is open. We loved it. It killed the entire third act.

item.title: Why we said no to the streaming deal.
item.description: Some thoughts on patience, on ownership, and on the math of a boutique studio that intends to stay one.

item.title: Drop 01 is live: The Ashen Man.
item.description: Five hundred numbered hoodies, two figurines, a board game, and a few quieter pieces. They go up tonight.

item.title: Red Winter, second printing — what changed.
item.description: First-edition errata, the rules clarification doc that grew into a small zine, and the four house rules we made official.

item.title: Why patient is in our manifesto.
item.description: Not slow, not lazy, not avoidant. Patient in the way a good interrogator is patient.

item.title: Sitges. We won. Here's the speech we didn't give.
item.description: The Painting took Best Short at Sitges and we were not in the room. Here's the speech that lived in the editing software.
